status_effects.explanation: Odette is locally credited with a mysterious prestige comparable to or greater than Gilberte's own, owing to her authority over her daughter's life.
Swann's polite but impersonal greeting, showing no sign of recognizing the narrator despite prior acquaintance, mildly excludes him from personal acknowledgment.

appraisal_events.evidence: "lui et Odette [...] contenaient pour moi, comme Gilberte, peut-être même plus que Gilberte [...] un inconnu inaccessible, un charme douloureux."
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator extends to Odette, alongside Swann, an aura of inaccessible mystery and painful charm as one of the powerful figures whose authority over Gilberte's life fascinates him, arguably surpassing even Gilberte herself in this respect.

appraisal_events.evidence: "Il répondait poliment aux saluts des camarades de Gilberte, même au mien quoiqu'il fût brouillé avec ma famille, mais sans avoir l'air de me connaître."
appraisal_events.explanation: Although Swann had often seen the narrator at Combray, he greets him politely but shows no sign of personally recognizing him, mildly dismissing him as just one of Gilberte's playmates.
